notes: «عن أبيه، عن جده» are two bare relations with no name: relation links.
«قال عبد الرحمن بن عوف إني لفي الصف» : the Companion is the speaker of the report, the last link. The two youths in the scene («فتيان») ask him inside the story: not links.
«وهما ابنا عفراء» is a remark in the text, not a transmitter: left out.
